```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(naniar)
library(validate)
library(validatetools)
library(dcmodify)
library(errorlocate)
kosz <- read.csv("players_stats_by_season_full_details.csv")
```

# 1. Wprowadzenie
# 2. Porządkowanie i czyszczenie danych
## 2.1 Braki danych

```{r}
vis_miss(kosz, warn_large_data = FALSE)


```

```{r}
gg_miss_fct(kosz, fct = League)


```


```{r}
# tutaj usuniemy niepotrzebne kolumny
kosz$weight <- NULL
kosz$height <- NULL
kosz <- kosz %>%
  mutate(id = row_number(), .before = 1)
```

```{r}
attach(kosz)
rules <- validator(
  ORB + DRB == REB,
  birth_year > 1940,
  FGM <= FGA,
  X3PM <= X3PA,
  FTM <= FTA,
  weight_kg > 0,
  weight_kg < 200,
  height_cm > 0,
  height_cm < 300
)
detach(kosz)
```

```{r}
cf <- confront(kosz, rules, key = "id")

barplot(cf)
```
